[E2] (text, Section 3.1, page 3): Pooling Layer. Pooling functions reduce the dimensionality of the input by calculating the mean or the maximum value. A pooling layer will partition the input into a set of non-overlapping rectangle sub-areas and perform the mean or the maximum function on each sub-area. These two types of functions correspond to mean pooling and max pooling, respectively. Fully Connected Layer (FC).
